title: Listening: A new flat
goal: Understand a phone call about a new flat, and practise there is / there are, prepositions of place and the past simple.
goal_it: Capire una telefonata su un nuovo appartamento ed esercitare there is / there are, le preposizioni di luogo e il past simple.

steps.title: Today's situation
en: You will hear a phone call between two friends. Emma has just moved into a new flat. Her friend Jack asks about the move and about the flat.
Listen for three things: how the move went, where things are in the rooms, and what the flat is like. First, learn the words below.
it: Sentirai una telefonata tra due amici. Emma si è appena trasferita in un nuovo appartamento. L'amico Jack le chiede del trasloco e della casa.
Ascolta tre cose: com'è andato il trasloco, dove sono le cose nelle stanze e com'è l'appartamento. Prima impara le parole qui sotto.

steps.title: Words you need
en: Learn these words before you listen.
it: Impara queste parole prima di ascoltare.

steps.title: Describing a room and telling the story of a move
steps.title_it: Descrivere una stanza e raccontare un trasloco
en: To say what is in a room we use there is (one thing) and there are (more things): There is a lamp. There are two chairs. The negative is there isn't a... / there aren't any...
To say where things are we use the prepositions of place: in, on, under, above, between, next to, opposite, close to.
To tell what happened in the move we use the past simple: arrived, carried, bought, finished. Notice the time word yesterday.
it: Per dire cosa c'è in una stanza si usa there is (una cosa) e there are (più cose): There is a lamp. There are two chairs. La negativa è there isn't a... / there aren't any...
Per dire dove sono le cose si usano le preposizioni di luogo: in, on, under, above, between, next to, opposite, close to.
Per raccontare cosa è successo nel trasloco si usa il past simple: arrived, carried, bought, finished. Nota la parola di tempo yesterday.

head: Use
Example
rows: There is a sofa. There are two windows.
The lamp is on the table, next to the sofa.

examples.en: There is a rug under the table.
examples.it: C'è un tappeto sotto il tavolo.

options: It makes you feel very tired
steps.why: A tiring day makes you tired.

steps.q: The room has a big window, so it is very ___.
steps.q_it: La stanza ha una grande finestra, quindi è molto luminosa.

options: There are two cupboards in the kitchen.
There is two cupboards in the kitchen.
There are a cupboard in the kitchen.
There be two cupboards in the kitchen.
steps.why: Two cupboards is plural, so we use there are.
steps.why_it: Two cupboards è plurale, quindi si usa there are.

steps.q: The lamp is ___ the table. It is on top of it.
steps.q_it: La lampada è sul tavolo, appoggiata sopra.
steps.why: On means on top, touching the surface.
steps.why_it: On significa sopra, a contatto con la superficie.

steps.q_it: Ieri abbiamo portato scatoloni tutta la mattina.
steps.why: Yesterday needs the past simple. Carry becomes carried.
steps.why_it: Yesterday vuole il past simple. Carry diventa carried.

steps.title: Listen to the phone call
en: Press Listen. You can listen as many times as you like. Try to find out: How was the move? Where is the sofa? What is missing in the kitchen?
it: Premi Ascolta. Puoi riascoltare quante volte vuoi. Cerca di capire: com'è andato il trasloco? Dov'è il divano? Cosa manca in cucina?

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: Hi Emma, how was the move?
script.it: Ciao Emma, com'è andato il trasloco?

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Tiring, but we finished yesterday. The van arrived at eight and we carried boxes all morning.
script.it: Faticoso, ma abbiamo finito ieri. Il furgone è arrivato alle otto e abbiamo portato scatoloni tutta la mattina.

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: What is the new flat like?
script.it: Com'è il nuovo appartamento?

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: It's small but bright. There is a big window in the living room, opposite the door.
script.it: È piccolo ma luminoso. C'è una grande finestra in soggiorno, di fronte alla porta.

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: Where did you put the sofa?
script.it: Dove hai messo il divano?

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Between the window and the bookcase. The lamp is on a small table next to it.
script.it: Tra la finestra e la libreria. La lampada è su un tavolino accanto.

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: And the kitchen?
script.it: E la cucina?

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: There are two cupboards above the cooker, but there isn't a dishwasher. We bought a new fridge yesterday.
script.it: Ci sono due pensili sopra i fornelli, ma non c'è la lavastoviglie. Ieri abbiamo comprato un frigorifero nuovo.

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: Is it near the shops?
script.it: È vicino ai negozi?

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Yes, the supermarket is close to the building. Come and see it on Saturday!
script.it: Sì, il supermercato è vicino al palazzo. Vieni a vederlo sabato!

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: Great idea. I will bring a plant for the bedroom.
script.it: Ottima idea. Porto una pianta per la camera da letto.

steps.q_it: Quando ha finito di traslocare Emma?

options: Between the window and the bookcase
steps.why: Emma says: between the window and the bookcase.
steps.why_it: Emma dice: between the window and the bookcase.

steps.q: What is there not in the kitchen?
steps.why: Emma says there isn't a dishwasher.
steps.why_it: Emma dice che there isn't a dishwasher.

steps.q: What does Jack decide to do?
steps.why: Jack says he will bring a plant, so he will visit.
steps.why_it: Jack dice che porterà una pianta, quindi andrà a trovarla.

steps.title: Listen again with the text
en: Now read and listen at the same time. Notice there is and there are, the prepositions of place and the past simple.
it: Ora leggi e ascolta insieme. Nota there is e there are, le preposizioni di luogo e il past simple.

steps.q: What time did the van arrive?
steps.q_it: A che ora è arrivato il furgone?
steps.why: The sentence says the van arrived at eight.
steps.why_it: La frase dice che il furgone è arrivato alle otto.

steps.q: What is missing in the kitchen?
steps.why: The sentence says there isn't a dishwasher.
steps.why_it: La frase dice there isn't a dishwasher.

steps.why: Past simple: carried, a finished action.

answers: The sofa is between the window and the bookcase
steps.why: Between means tra, with two things.
steps.why_it: Between significa tra, con due cose.
steps.audio: The sofa is between the window and the bookcase.

answers: We bought a new fridge yesterday
steps.audio: We bought a new fridge yesterday.

answers: The supermarket is close to the building
steps.why: Close to means molto vicino a.
steps.why_it: Close to significa molto vicino a.
steps.audio: The supermarket is close to the building.

steps.title: Keep listening this week
en: Choose one short recording at B1 level and listen twice. The first time, listen without help. The second time, read the transcript if there is one.
BBC Learning English also has the programme 6 Minute English: you can find it in your podcast app.
it: Scegli una breve registrazione di livello B1 e ascoltala due volte. La prima volta senza aiuti. La seconda leggi la trascrizione, se c'è.
Anche BBC Learning English ha il programma 6 Minute English: lo trovi nella tua app di podcast.
